metadata.method: Same five candidate models/descriptions, ten English and ten Chinese requests, one run per engine. Local Laya uses English/multilingual checkpoints on an Apple M4 Pro GPU.
limitations: Expected labels were assigned by one person and many requests mirror wording in model descriptions.
Some requests were previously successful Jev examples; the test is not blind holdout evidence.
Local Laya median 54ms is a direct-call timing; later 127ms router timing uses a different measurement boundary.
Self-hosted absence of per-call billing excludes hardware and operations cost.
Published zero-shot/fine-tuned model-card figures are separate claims and must not be merged with these 20-case results.
